description: Export a deck (id or name) as plain decklist text: Commander section first when set (both of a pair), then a Companion section when the deck names one, then the "N Card Name" lines of the main deck, then a Sideboard section when there is one, the companion repeated there as Arena writes it (pinned printings keep their set/collector number). import_deck reads it back whole.
name: export_deck
title: Export deck
